messages:
anya: opened PR to add a "rollback & deprecation" section to the model catalog for the Meridian family. It includes steps for safe rollback, a short checklist for customers, and a note about how deprecations propagate to variant routing. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5342
devin: important to include concrete fallback semantics. If a variant is rolled back and the pinned version is removed, the platform will route to the most recent compatible variant and emit audit event MODEL_ROLLBACK_FALLBACK. Customers should monitor that event.
anya: good call. I'll add the exact event name and an example audit log line.
marta: also add a tiny bench delta table and a short SDK snippet showing how to pin to a previous release vs family-stable. Example snippet suggestion:
```
# pin to an explicit older revision for rollback
client.generate(model="meridian-7b@2025-08-10", prompt="...")
# family-stable pin (allows compatible variants)
client.generate(model="meridian-7b@stable", prompt="...")
```
devin: bench numbers: p4d fp16 meridian-7b pinned (2025-08-10) ~710 toks/s; meridian-7b-quant fallback ~605 toks/s; with runtime 3.2 + selector quant reaches ~690 toks/s. Add measurement note: batch=1, seq=512, coldstart vs warmed.
anya: will paste CSV into PR. Also discovered a stale docs link to docs/legacy-quantation.md in the Meridian card; need to replace with docs/quant/quickstart.md and add a redirect.
marta: I'll open the redirect PR after this merges. Tiny UX note: put the rollback checklist under a top-level "Operational guidance" section so it's easier for SREs to find.
anya: done. Assigning follow-ups: devin  bench CSV + log; marta  redirect PR + snippet formatting; I'll update the PR today and request reviews.
docs-bot: PR #5342 opened by anya: docs/model-catalog: meridian rollback + deprecation guidance (labels: docs, model-catalog)
devin: one wording nit: prefer active phrasing like "the platform will route" instead of "may route" for the fallback description. Clarity is better.
marta: +1 on wording. Also add a short line recommending family pins for canary-friendly rollouts.
anya: updated wording and added family-pin recommendation. Will merge after CI + one approval. Ping me for urgent copy nits.
devin: LGTM once CSV is attached.
marta: +1
anya: merging after CI then, thanks everyone! :shipit:
